mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_sheet (name, grade_tag_id, total_count, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{gradeTagId}, #{totalCount}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO exam_sheet_problem (exam_sheet_id, problem_id, sort_order) VALUES
(#{examSheetId}, #{esp.problemId}, #{esp.sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, grade_tag_id AS gradeTagId, total_count AS totalCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM exam_sheet WHERE created_by = #{createdBy} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT exam_sheet_id AS examSheetId, problem_id AS problemId, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM exam_sheet_problem WHERE exam_sheet_id = #{examSheetId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
